name: carnet-way-in-pin
about: A code whose member must choose a PIN (needs_pin): the PIN typed twice, sent with the new token, then the shelf.

steps.see: Enter a code or an address

steps.tap: Enter a code or an address

accepted.why: The way in, as the household sees it, is the same: Android sends the code as the server reads it (ABCDEFGH; the server normalises ABCD-EFGH alike), checks /api/health once where iOS checks it twice, asks /api/dictation at sign-in, and loads the shelf once the notice is accepted where iOS loads it behind the notice — the same requests, across two checkpoints.
